internal.name: ObjectiveTimezoneService
internal.rule: setting change never mutates persisted Task/Objective instants; wall-clock preservation requires reviewed Task plan revisions

internal.name: WfmImportReader
internal.rule: matches LLD-04; RETIRED is never adoption/create target; base token covers identity/current RFC/source projection/current plan/membership/lock revisions relevant to proposal

internal.name: WfmImportMutationService
internal.contract: caller supplies outer LLD-04 UoW/receipt. Exact Task No. adopts existing WFM; source projection changes no execution/outcome/membership; reviewed source plan appends Task plan but never silently repins Objective membership; mismatch becomes regroup input.

internal.name: RfcTerminalTaskParticipant
internal.contract: preview/revalidate own exact Task/Objective impact; apply uses caller UoW after proof/outer receipt and returns only bounded summary; hard-delete classification is read-only; participant never commits

internal.name: RfcHistoryRiskProvider
internal.rule: read-only in Snapshot or writer UoW. READY returns LOW|HIGH, exact evidence count and fingerprint; INDETERMINATE fails closed. Exact evidence semantics are owned by interfaces/cross-packet-v2.json; no Task/WFM/Objective rows cross into LLD-03.

internal.name: InventoryTaskDependencyProvider
internal.rule: matches LLD-07; LLD-05 never rewrites Inventory history; protected Inventory history blocks Task hard delete; retry copies only explicitly selected current eligible planning relationships

internal.name: TaskOperationalEvidenceReader
internal.rule: Read-only accepted operational evidence; accepts either one stable LLD-01 Snapshot or the current supplied writer UnitOfWork read context and never mutates/commits. TaskOperationalExecutionV1 is exact {execution_revision:int>=0,execution_state:'not_started|in_progress|ended|terminated',actual_start_utc:int|null,actual_end_utc:int|null,effective_termination_utc:int|null,termination_reason:string|null,last_event_id:uuid|null}. Exact absence is revision=0/not_started with all nullable fields null; any positive history/projection disagreement fails closed. TaskOperationalOutcomeV1 is null only when both task_outcome_current and owned task_outcome_events are exactly absent; otherwise it is exact {outcome_event_id:uuid,accepted_outcome:'completed|incomplete|cancelled_without_execution',reviewed_at_utc:int>=0,outcome_revision:int>=1}. Current projection must equal the unique linear immutable chain tip or the reader fails closed. TaskOperationalObjectiveContextV1 is null only when objective_task_membership_current is absent; otherwise it is exact {objective_id:uuid,membership_revision:int>=1,accepted_plan_revision_id:uuid,membership_last_event_id:uuid,objective_revision:int>=1,envelope_revision:int>=1,aggregate_revision:int>=1,aggregate_input_fingerprint:lowercase sha256}. Missing/corrupt current Objective projection fails closed. review_fingerprint is SOMA_TASK_OPERATIONAL_EVIDENCE_V1: SHA-256 over LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical JSON UTF-8 bytes for {schema:'SOMA_TASK_OPERATIONAL_EVIDENCE_V1',task_id,execution:task_execution(...),outcome:task_outcome(...),objective_context:objective_context(...)}. It deliberately excludes Task plan/source/lock/general Task revision that do not change these operational facts. Any included execution event/projection change, outcome review/correction, current Objective membership move/repin, Objective revision, envelope revision, aggregate revision or aggregate input fingerprint change changes the digest.

registry_contract: This bounded registry preserves the exact internal service and participant declarations formerly held in the LLD-05 omnibus interfaces.json.
Canonical cross-packet provider and consumer signatures remain owned by interfaces/cross-packet-v2.json.
